enable_logic.drive_source: Q1 emitter net VPD (own input upstream of D10); never +12V or VIN
enable_logic.equation: EN_N - V(-12V) = Q1 on ? (VPD - VCEsat - V(-12V))*R18/(R17+R18) : Ileak*R18
enable_logic.logic: U4 enabled iff own VPD AND RUN AND MAIN_LED_OK (derived from the netlist, not assumed)
enable_logic.method: Structure traced from the design connectivity (LMR38020 EN pin -> divider -> PNP collector -> base pull-ups and series NMOS sink chain -> GND; S9.3: the RC-delayed P12_OK gate of the top switch, evaluated settled); bounds over VPD 12.26/16.5/19.44 V, resistor tolerance + TCR, NMOS VGS(th) 1.0-2.5 V with 1 uA leakage, PNP hFE >= 60, VEB <= 0.35 V off and 5 uA leakage. With a switch open the switches above it are source followers (node <= gate), so the chain current is bounded by the node defaults; a chain node with no DC default is undefined. Required: U4 enabled iff own input AND RUN AND MAIN_LED_OK AND +12V good (P12_OK).
enable_logic.off_pullup: R112 ties Q1 base to VPD; R115 100k defines N_EN_RETURN; R18 pulls EN to the U4 ground
enable_logic.supply_loss_response: MAIN_OK has falling deglitch; until it drops a powered converter can sink a bus. Clamp test bounds that finite interval; never parallel a running module.
